-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Box[T any] struct {
	V int
}

func (b Box[T]) Add(x, y int) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return x + y + n + b.V
}

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B string
}

func pair() (int, int) {
	return 2, 3
}

func use[T any](b Box[T]) int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return b.Add(pair())
	}
	return -1
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(use[Pair](Box[Pair]{V: 5}))
}
